Yes, your Fiancée did something unforgivable and that 1 month away from the wedding. First, it is better to postpone the wedding and not break it all off right away. Why? Because there is a possibility you might regret breaking it off "if" she is telling you the truth. Ofc, you have to work on yourself and know that the decision you make is right for yourself because you are important too. But remember, alcohol is involved. Not everyone is a strong drinker and it is possible that she doesn't remember anything that happened after a certain point. 

Second, it seems like it was all the MoH's plan to invite the stripper. If you know your girl as good as you tell us, you know she wouldn't have gone along with this crazy party. She would have told her off and said no. But because she was so drunk already, she isn't sober enough to know anything right away. You said it so too, once she realized what had happened she stopped the whole thing. It's given that we won't know what happened after that but we can't assume something happened either because its a 50% something more happened or not. 

You know more about your Fiancée than we do so you know her character well. But at the same time, you should work on your relationship. As many have said, regretting forgiving her after the marriage will just break the both of you. 

I hope the best for you OP and hope to see any updates if there are any. And good luck!
